title: I just updated my game and experimented with AI to create a trailer. What do you think?
author: FJWY
selftext:
I've recently released an update for my game and wanted to create a short trailer to showcase the new content and improvements on social media.

Instead of recording gameplay myself, I experimented with Claude AI. I trained it to play my game using bots, identify interesting and exciting moments, and save the best clips to use in the final video.

The trailer was then created using those selected gameplay moments.

I'm curious to hear what you think about the result!

Does the trailer work as a way to showcase the game? Would it catch your attention on social media?

Feedback is very welcome!
